title: Neural Collapse on Imbalanced Datasets and Open-Set Scenario
abstract: arXiv:2611.07753v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural collapse (NC) describes the elegant geometric structure that sample features and classifier vectors exhibit when a classification model's loss reaches its minimum. Class imbalance, however, generally distorts standard NC. In this paper, we theoretically reformulate NC on imbalanced datasets and in open-set settings. Our analysis is based on an optimization problem over class-wise averaged losses, rather than the global averaged losses used in prior NC studies. We prove that when class-wise averaged losses attain their minima, standard NC is achieved on balanced or imbalanced datasets, for both cross-entropy (CE) and binary cross-entropy (BCE) losses. We further extend the analysis to an open-set-inspired scenario, where some classes contain no training samples yet are still assigned classifier vectors in the losses. translated_title: 不平衡数据集与开集场景下的神经坍缩
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.07753v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：神经坍缩（NC）描述了当分类模型的损失达到最小值时，样本特征和分类器向量所呈现出的优雅几何结构。然而，类别不平衡通常会扭曲标准的神经坍缩现象。本文从理论上重新表述了不平衡数据集和开集设置下的神经坍缩。我们的分析基于对各类别平均损失的优化问题，而非以往神经坍缩研究中采用的全局平均损失。我们证明了当各类别平均损失达到其最小值时，无论数据集是平衡的还是不平衡的，对于交叉熵（CE）和二元交叉熵（BCE）损失，标准的神经坍缩均可实现。我们进一步将该分析扩展到一种受开集启发的场景，其中某些类别不包含任何训练样本，但在损失函数中仍被分配了分类器向量。我们发现，在这种场景下，当各类别平均损失达到其最小值时，标准的神经坍缩现象仍然会出现。
tldr: 本文基于类别平均损失（而非全局平均损失）的优化理论，证明了无论数据集是否平衡，甚至在部分类别完全没有训练样本的开集场景下，当各类别平均损失达到最小值时，标准的神经坍缩结构依然会涌现。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically proves, based on optimization over class-wise averaged losses rather than global averaged losses, that standard neural collapse still emerges when class-wise averaged losses attain their minima, even on imbalanced datasets and in open-set scenarios where some classes contain no training samples at all.
